At the heart of child-rearing success lies the unique, non-interchangeable contributions of mothers and fathers. Human children are born helpless, requiring the longest parental investment of any mammal. Deviating from this blueprint invites harm. LGBTQ+ adoption denies this birthright, substituting adult fulfillment for proven science. Governments exist to protect the weak, not affirm every preference.
